usedFor: ActivityInfo collects records from forms in the field; HubSpot tracks the relationships behind them. A “New Record” in ActivityInfo can run “Create Deal” so a new form entry opens a deal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new record in a chosen form is one clear event, so each submission becomes a deal your team can follow.

watchOut: Both ActivityInfo triggers are polling, so deals appear after the next check. “Updated Record” fires on every change, and “Update Deal” needs a deal ID.
